lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Another day.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Another cup of coffee.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Buzzing horns. A city full of strangers. A phone full of notifications.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So many people. So little warmth.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: The world — it feels distant.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Who even sends letters anymore?

lines.speaker: narration
lines.text: The book opens to the first page. The words appear slowly, as if being written by an unseen hand.

lines.speaker: book
lines.text: The book always finds those who need it the most. Follow the path — a soulful awakening awaits you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: This has to be a joke... right?

lines.speaker: narration
lines.text: You run your finger down the list. One name glows.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Punjab...

state_index.name: Punjab
state_index.description: Where love, generosity and courage flows like its rivers.

state_index.name: Bengal
state_index.description: Where art breathes and poetry sings.

state_index.name: Nagaland
state_index.description: Where the hills remember every song.

lines.speaker: meher
lines.text: I am Meher. Your companion and guide for this journey.

lines.speaker: meher
lines.text: The book found you for a reason. You do not have to understand it yet. You only have to follow.

lines.speaker: meher
lines.text: Punjab will not fix you. It will simply remind you what it means to be whole again.

lines.speaker: meher
lines.text: So go. Board the train.

lines.speaker: meher
lines.text: Look outside. Really look.

lines.speaker: meher
lines.text: Punjab is much like its fields — generous and content, yet sturdy and courageous.

lines.speaker: meher
lines.text: You have spent so long rushing. Here, you must pause. Life is an experience, after all. And experiences are meant to be felt, not survived.

lines.speaker: meher
lines.text: A family will welcome you when you arrive. They do not know you, but they will welcome you anyway. That is the spirit of Punjab — they hold human connection above all else.

lines.speaker: meher
lines.text: Watch them. Learn from them.

lines.speaker: family
lines.text: Welcome. We have been awaiting you.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.text: Meher always knows who needs the village — and whom the village needs. Come. Let us take you home.

lines.speaker: father
lines.text: You must be tired. The city takes more than it gives, no? Here, you will get it back.

lines.speaker: daughter
lines.text: These are for you. They bloom every morning, no matter what. Like us.

lines.speaker: meher
lines.text: Welcome to Punjab, traveler. Your journey begins here.
